Release: https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui/releases/tag/v5.34.0
Usage reference: https://swagger.io/docs/open-source-tools/swagger-ui/usage/installation/

Unmodified downloads from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui/v5.34.0/:
- `dist/swagger-ui-bundle.js`
- `dist/swagger-ui.css`
- `LICENSE` (Apache-2.0)

The bundle, CSS, LICENSE and NOTICE are embedded and served. The default BaseLayout does not require the standalone preset. Source maps, favicons, OAuth redirect and upstream index/initializer are omitted. Runtime uses no CDN or remote validator. Source-map comments in upstream assets are retained; maps are not shipped.
